_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Workspace mode doesn't seed a user: filter that hides API-started tasks. The server runs in workspace mode; the browser is signed in as me@example.com. A project has two tasks: {{SHARED}}, in which several people (me@example.com and colleague@example.com) wrote, which would seed a "user:<me>" search filter in stock Shelley, and {{API_STARTED}}, started through the API, with no human author. The conversation list the page loads says so, and the page's live stream is cut off so that it keeps that list. On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Click the button named exactly "Open tasks". 3. The element [data-conversation-id="{{SHARED}}"] should be visible. 4. The element [data-conversation-id="{{API_STARTED}}"] should be visible. 5. The button named "Search tasks..." must not have the class "search-toggle-active" (no search filter was seeded).
